documents.response:
Document Checklists:
• ITR Filing: PAN, Aadhaar, Form 16 / Salary slips, Bank statement, Investment proofs (80C / 80D), Capital Gain statements.
• GST Registration: Business PAN, Electricity bill / Rent agreement, Cancelled cheque, Aadhaar of proprietor / partners.
• Company Incorporation: PAN & Aadhaar of Directors, Passport photo, Bank statement (latest 2 months), Electricity bill of registered office.

View Complete Document Guide ->
